# Lucide Browser Bundle

Unmodified `dist/umd/lucide.min.js` from the official npm package `lucide@0.468.0`.
This is the same pinned browser build previously loaded from unpkg. Serving it
from AgentLab avoids blank icon controls when the external CDN is unavailable.

The ISC license and upstream copyright notice are retained in `LICENSE`.
`SOURCES.json` records the package source and bundle checksum. No new runtime
dependency, icon API, or package-lock change is introduced.
